scope: Procedural Three.js crystal flora matching the existing Blender island asset
flowers: Preserved all seven emotion silhouettes, waveform lengths, growth rotations, droop, shiver, scale and alternating pair colors.
Added a shallow mineral keel, beveled pearl margins and lavender-tinted inner petals with fewer longitudinal segments.
Shared opaque MeshPhysicalMaterial with roughness 0.34, metalness 0.07, clearcoat 0.22, iridescence 0.22 and zero transmission.
Faceted, non-emissive center and champagne octahedral stamens. Pair colors subtly blend at the base while remaining distinct at the tips.
Detail preview uses the garden sky reflection rig at 64-pixel PMREM resolution and neutral tone mapping.
trees: Rose-brown mineral trunks and branches. Opal foliage shares the flower material family with roughness 0.31.
Round trees retain clustered crowns, pine retains narrowing tiers with beveled mineral edges, willow retains drooping branches with small elongated crystal leaves.
Shared cut geometries within each tree. Existing sound-derived kind, size, branch count and lengths remain intact.
otherFixes: Garden now passes all source rows to Island3D so pair flowers can resolve both partners. The renderer already excludes ordinary own-source flowers.
Detail shape key includes emotion category.
Shared resources dispose once and friend dimming reuses each plant-owned material.

verification.build: npm run build passed, Vite 5.4.21, 122 modules. Existing chunk-size warning remains.
verification.runtimeCases: 292 cases covering seven emotions, legacy rows, vowels/consonants, three tree kinds and pairs. Finite attributes, matching growth/headY, opaque materials and one disposal per shared resource.
verification.browser: Chrome on Windows with Intel Arc 140V via ANGLE D3D11. Zero page/shader errors in screenshot scenarios.
verification.interactions: Flower/tree/pair raycast selection and detail growth passed.
verification.gpu: Two runs per version, 120 warmup frames and 180 GPU timer samples each. Same 52 plants, 585x981 render resolution. Baseline gets the pair input correction through test interception.
